info.title: Sanctions Screening Service API
info.description:
SVC-051 — Sanctions Screening Service. Provides synchronous, stateless real-time screening against global sanctions lists for JRN-001 (Personal Current Account Opening) and all other customer-facing journeys requiring CDD.

SVC-051 is a stateless API — it does not persist results. It screens against: OFSI Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, and EU Sanctions Lists. Results are persisted by the caller (SVC-014, which stores the result in KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result).

Design: Stateless by design (see service-boundaries.json DD-SVC014-01). The architectural decision to keep SVC-051 stateless keeps it lightweight, independently scalable, and free from persistence infrastructure. Ownership of screening outcomes sits with SVC-014 (the MLRO-governed CDD service).

Regulatory context: GOV-005-R02 mandates real-time sanctions screening — batch-end or deferred screening is non-compliant per OFSI obligation. Hard latency limit: <3,000ms in all conditions (nfr.json PH-003 sanctions_screening_hard_limit_ms). 100% applicant coverage is mandatory — the Starling Bank FCA enforcement action (£29m, October 2024) for incomplete screening establishes direct precedent. A 'blocked' result must immediately halt account opening with no exceptions.

tags.name: Sanctions
tags.description: Synchronous real-time sanctions screening. Stateless — results are not persisted by SVC-051. Hard SLA: <3,000ms. 100% applicant coverage required.

post.description:
Screens an individual against all configured sanctions lists (OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU) in a single synchronous call. Returns a result within the 3,000ms hard limit (NFR GOV-005-R02). This endpoint is stateless — results are not persisted; the caller (SVC-014) is responsible for persisting the result in KycAssessment.

Screening covers:
- OFSI Consolidated List (HM Treasury UK)
- OFAC SDN List (US Treasury)
- UN Consolidated List (UN Security Council)
- EU Financial Sanctions List (OFAC mirror + EU-specific)

Additional vendor-supplied lists (ComplyAdvantage/Refinitiv World-Check) may supplement the above based on SVC-051 configuration.

A 'blocked' result must be acted upon immediately by the caller. The caller must publish SanctionsHitDetected to SVC-102 and halt the application. The customer must not be informed of the specific reason (tipping-off prohibition, POCA 2002 s333A).

Phase: PH-003 (KYC/CDD Assessment) — called by SVC-014
Governance: GOV-005-R02, OFSI regulations, POCA 2002 s333A (tipping-off).

individual_dual_nationality.summary: Screen individual — dual nationality including high-risk jurisdiction

200.description: Screening completed within SLA. Result returned synchronously. Caller must act on 'blocked' result immediately.

match_detail.designation_description: Listed individual under UK Russia Sanctions Regulations 2019

value.caller_action_required: IMMEDIATE_BLOCK — publish SanctionsHitDetected to event bus. Do not proceed with account opening. Do not disclose reason to customer (POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition). Notify MLRO. OFSI notification required within 14 days of confirmed designated person identification.

pending_review.summary: Screening result — PENDING REVIEW (possible match, manual review required)

match_detail.note: Match confidence below 85% threshold. Manual review required before proceeding.

429.description: Too Many Requests. SVC-051 rate limit exceeded. Retry after the period indicated in the Retry-After header. The caller must not proceed with account opening while awaiting a sanctions result — the application must be paused.

value.message: Sanctions screening rate limit exceeded. Retry after 5 seconds.
value.detail: Application paused. A sanctions result must be obtained before account opening can proceed (GOV-005-R02). Do not open the account while rate limited.

503.description: Service Unavailable. SVC-051 or the underlying sanctions data vendor is unavailable. The caller must not proceed with account opening. The application must be queued for retry. Retry using exponential backoff. If unavailability exceeds 30 minutes, the customer must be notified of the delay (nfr.json PH-003 degraded mode).

value.message: The sanctions screening service is temporarily unavailable.
value.detail: Account opening cannot proceed without a completed sanctions check. The application has been queued. Estimated recovery: 5 minutes.

BearerAuth.description: Service-to-service JWT. Required scope: `sanctions-screening:execute`. Only SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service) and SVC-050 (Customer Onboarding Service) are authorised callers for the onboarding path. Post-onboarding portfolio rescreening may be triggered by SVC-014 with `sanctions-screening:batch:execute` scope.

screening_request_id.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Resubmitting the same screening_request_id within 60 seconds returns the cached result without re-screening. Format: scr-YYYYMMDD-{application_ref_suffix}.

entity_type.description: JRN-001 screens individuals only. Corporate entity screening is out of scope for this journey.

lists_to_check.description: Sanctions lists to screen against. All four lists must be checked per GOV-005-R02. Omitting any list is non-compliant.

match_threshold_percentage.description: Fuzzy match confidence threshold (%). Results above this threshold are classified as 'blocked' or 'pending_review'. Lowering below 85 increases false positives. Cannot be set below 70 (compliance floor).

date_of_birth.description: ISO 8601. Used as a secondary matching field to reduce false positives on common names.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Multiple nationalities must all be provided — screening must cover all nationality combinations.

residential_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of residence. Supplements nationality in screening.

aliases.description: Known alternative names or spellings. Screened in addition to the primary name.

ScreeningContext.description: Audit context for the screening request. Not used in matching logic — used for audit trail correlation only.

journey_id.description: Journey identifier (e.g. JRN-001). For audit and rate-limiting attribution.

SanctionsScreenResponse.description: Synchronous screening result. Stateless — not persisted by SVC-051. Caller (SVC-014) must persist in KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result.

screening_id.description: SVC-051-generated unique identifier for this screening event. Included in the caller's persisted record for audit trail.

status.description: 'clear' = no match above threshold. 'blocked' = confirmed match — halt application immediately. 'pending_review' = possible match below threshold — manual MLRO review required.

match_detail.description: null if status = 'clear'. Contains designated person detail if blocked or pending_review. Sensitive — access-controlled in the caller's persistence layer (SVC-014).

processing_time_ms.description: End-to-end processing time in milliseconds. Must be < 3000 per GOV-005-R02 SLA. If this field exceeds 3000, the SVC-051 team must be alerted.

screened_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the screening completed.

list_data_freshness.description: Timestamps of the most recent data refresh for each list. Used to confirm list currency at time of screening (OFSI compliance evidence).

caller_action_required.description: Machine-readable action instruction for 'blocked' results. Present only when status = 'blocked' to prompt the caller to publish SanctionsHitDetected and halt account opening.
